anyOf.$comment: forbidden Realm authorship field; canonical name is created_by
forbidden Realm addressing field; the only alias carrier is the ak.realm.alias Event (ak.component.realm.alias.v1). See zh/discovery/object-addressing.md section 3.3.
forbidden Realm policy field; the only carrier is the ak.realm.plaintext_visible_services facet cell. See zh/sync/service-surface.md.

id.description: Present on the materialised object. MUST be absent from the create Event payload: zh/models/common-fields.md derives it from the create Event's own event_id (retyped), so a payload-supplied id would be a second, forgeable truth.

security_class.description: Optional security class. 'high_assurance' forbids federation_policy=open and SHOULD use stricter resolver/E2EE/audit defaults. Omitted = 'standard'.

trust_domain.description: Immutable deployment trust domain captured by ak.realm.create. Receivers MUST require this to match the current Realm trust domain before accepting cross-domain replay-sensitive proofs.

owning_organization_ids.description: Declared or projected organization principals associated with this Realm. Each DID MUST resolve to an Organization principal. This field alone is not a verified ownership/governance endorsement; clients and directories MUST require an active ak.realm.organization statement for verified badges or organization-controlled semantics.

schema_refs.description: Create-locked union of registered schema ids and the closed Realm structural-role profile allowlist. Policy, deployment conformance and operation-local profiles are forbidden here.

fields.description: Product/profile fields. Security-relevant discriminators such as purpose in {principal_control, managed_agent_control} and collaboration_role=direct_conversation are schema constrained below; other product fields remain extension-defined.

relation_profiles.description: Optional Relation cardinality and conflict profiles declared by this Realm schema/profile.

relation_scope.description: Cardinality and dedupe scope. realm is the default; space scopes to a Space and board is shorthand for a kind=board Space. There is no global scope: a Realm-local reducer has no cross-Realm state to enforce one against.

on_conflict.description: Conflict handling for mutually unreachable Relation candidates. require_review retains the complete bounded head set and projects no active winner until an explicit resolution covers every current head.

preview_policy_id.description: Optional materialized pointer to the effective preview / peek policy. Canonical writes use ak.realm.preview_policy; absence means directory card / stripped state only, no history stub/snippet preview.

default_strand_id.description: Optional / nullable. AUTHORITATIVE single pointer to the Realm's default discussion Strand (last value projected from ak.realm.set_default_strand; cell ak.component.realm.set_default_strand.v1, cas_register, bottom=reject). A single pointer avoids multi-default dirty state. null / absent means the Realm has no designated default Strand. The reducer rejects a set_default_strand whose strand_id does not resolve to a projected non-tombstoned Strand in this Realm (failed_precondition), so this pointer never dangles. The Strand projection's derived is_default flag is computed as strand_id == this value; clients discover the default Strand deterministically from this field (or the Strand is_default marker) and MUST NOT rely on any Strand-reuses-Realm-token implementation detail. See zh/models/strand-and-message.md (default-Strand discovery).

history_access.description: Scope-local history range ratchet initialized by Realm create. Only all_history_for_current_members to since_join may change state; widening back to all_history is permanently forbidden. Standard MLS requires since_join.

reducer_profile.description: Materialized value of the Realm reducer-profile singleton control cell. ak.realm.create supplies its genesis value; only ak.realm.upgrade may change it.

content_scheme.description: MLS content scheme, required exactly for encryption_profile=mls_rfc9420 and frozen by the accepted group Genesis. Allowed values are mls_rfc9420 and mls_exporter_aead_v1. It is never mutable policy state.

content_encryption_floor.description: Realm-wide content encryption floor (models/circle.md §7, models/realm-and-space.md §4). This is the Realm's actual content-encryption on/off switch. When e2ee_required, the effective_scope of Strand / Message / Morph / Blob content MUST be MLS-backed (Realm-default MLS or Circle MLS); reducer MUST failed_precondition (reason=content_encryption_floor_violation) on plaintext content. Independent of encryption_profile, which only declares the encryption MECHANISM (whether an MLS group exists), not which Arkret fields enter ciphertext. One-way ratchet: once the effective value has reached e2ee_required, a later policy write lowering it back to allow_plaintext MUST be rejected with content_encryption_floor_downgrade. Defaults to allow_plaintext when absent.

metadata_encryption_floor.description: Realm-wide metadata encryption floor (models/circle.md §7), binary and symmetric with content_encryption_floor. allow_plaintext lets user-readable metadata stay wire-plaintext; e2ee_required forces it into encrypted_metadata. Comparison order allow_plaintext < e2ee_required. Effective floor = max(parent Realm value, Circle metadata floor, object profile requirement); any write below the effective floor MUST failed_precondition (reason=metadata_encryption_floor_violation). MUST NOT be relaxed by Circle, Space, or object profile. Space does not carry a metadata floor value. One-way ratchet: once the effective value has reached e2ee_required, a later policy write lowering it back to allow_plaintext MUST be rejected with metadata_encryption_floor_downgrade. When absent, reducers default to e2ee_required for mls_rfc9420 or content_encryption_floor=e2ee_required Realms, otherwise allow_plaintext.

agent_participation.description: Realm five-bit native Agent participation ceiling. It may only tighten the target-service safety ceiling and is itself the parent of Circle and Strand ceilings.

durability_policy.description: Exporter durability policy frozen by the accepted group Genesis. Required exactly when content_scheme=mls_exporter_aead_v1; otherwise absent. Allowed values are none and organization_recovery_key. It is never mutable policy state.

availability_policy.description: Realm policy component governing independently signed byte-availability receipts before Seal inclusion and before snapshot/backfill availability claims. Eligible holders are derived only from canonical recipient_id values in effective routable joined-member delivery bindings frozen at the predecessor view. The policy never creates an out-of-membership replication target. Absent means {min_holders:1,applies_to:['seal_include'],minimum_retention_ms:86400000}.

audit_policy.description: Realm policy component for range-completeness and seal-transparency witness admission. If absent, receivers MUST NOT accept a seal-transparency auditor attestation as verified v1 evidence, and federation_witness_attested range completeness has no admissible witness set.

digest_algorithm.description: Digest suite (canonicalization x hash tuple) used for DataEvent ids, Control Move ids, Seal ids, state_root, and Merkle leaves within this Realm. It is locked at create except for ak.realm.digest_suite_transition under ak.profile.hash_transition.v1. Defaults to sha256. Value space is the active rows of artifacts/registry/digest-suite-registry.json (this enum MUST be regenerated when a row flips active, e.g. cbor.sha256); bare ids denote canonical-JSON canonicalization, dotted ids denote alternate canonical encodings. Exactly one live suite per Realm; migration uses the control-plane transition Move and dual-root Seal defined by event-auth-state-resolution.md §9.3.2.

notary.description: Closed notary configuration. Every signer slot freezes actor, DID URL and exact public key. Successor changes are authorized by predecessor-state frozen descriptors before replacement is installed; current DID resolution is never substituted.

revocation_freshness_window_ms.description: Realm-level maximum historical basis grace, measured only as the notary-committed Seal-time distance between an old basis Seal and its successor revocation Seal along the Seal DAG (authz/event-auth-state-resolution.md section 4.3). The value is not a wall-clock TTL and does not age from Event signing, first delivery, receiver admission, or replay time. risk_tier=high capabilities get no grace (effective 0). Deployments needing real-time online revocation also use an independent runtime/session gate.

recovery_witness_freshness_window_ms.description: Maximum signed Seal.sealed_at distance from the conflict-detecting frontier to a state_witness used by a conflict-recovery Move. Receivers compute the non-negative DAG time delta from the witness Seal to the recovery Move's seal_basis leaves; exceeding this value fails closed with recovery_witness_revoke_lagging.

proposal_intake_sla_ms.description: Realm-level deadline within which a submitted control-plane Control Move MUST receive a signed Control Proposal Ack or signed ingress rejection (authz/event-auth-state-resolution.md section 7.2). This acknowledgement phase is separate from the Control Proposal Ack's bounded decision window. Silent omission past this SLA is governance-health evidence.

proposal_decision_window_ms.description: Realm-level default first decision window for an acknowledged Control Move. A Control Proposal Ack commits decision_due_at = received_at + an effective window no greater than this value and the protocol hard ceiling of 24 hours. The deadline requires a verifiable decision (include in an accepted Seal, signed reject, or bounded signed defer); it is not an acceptance or finality SLA.
proposal_decision_window_ms.$comment: Reducer/conformance validation MUST enforce proposal_decision_window_ms <= proposal_absolute_deadline_ms. If max_proposal_defers > 0, the inequality MUST be strict so at least one strictly later decision_due_at remains representable. JSON Schema cannot compare sibling numeric properties.

proposal_absolute_deadline_ms.description: Realm-level absolute proposal decision horizon measured from the Control Proposal Ack's signed received_at. absolute_due_at MUST equal received_at plus an effective value no greater than this field and the protocol hard ceiling of 72 hours. Signed defers MUST preserve absolute_due_at and cannot extend this horizon.
proposal_absolute_deadline_ms.$comment: Reducer/conformance validation owns the sibling-field ordering rule documented on proposal_decision_window_ms.

max_proposal_defers.description: Maximum cumulative number of signed defers for one acknowledged Control Move. The protocol hard ceiling is two. Every defer carries a closed reason code, increments defer_count by exactly one, advances decision_due_at without exceeding absolute_due_at, and preserves the Control Proposal Ack's absolute_due_at.
max_proposal_defers.$comment: When proposal_decision_window_ms equals proposal_absolute_deadline_ms this field MUST be 0; otherwise the declared defer count is not realizable.

seal_compaction_max_interval_ms.description: Structural obligation, not advisory: maximum interval between compaction Seals (Seals carrying covered_event_digests[] or an equivalent verifiable full-coverage manifest). Because the cumulative control-plane covered set is defined recursively from predecessor_refs + delta, compaction Seals are the only bounded bootstrap points for new verifiers; a notary that exceeds this interval degrades bootstrap to walking the chain to genesis. open_set deployments MUST use <= 86400000 (24h); threshold deployments MUST use <= 604800000 (7d); single_signer SHOULD use <= 86400000. Receivers SHOULD raise governance health alarms when the live chain exceeds the declared interval. See authz/event-auth-state-resolution.md section 6.2 and conformance vector ak.vector.cba_lattice.seal_compaction_interval_enforced.v1.

max_authority_lifetime_ms.description: Realm-level maximum lifetime window used when an otherwise unbounded parent grant first delegates. Reducers freeze authority_expiry_seal = first_delegation_sealed_at + effective max_authority_lifetime_ms and MUST NOT refresh it on re-delegation. Effective value is the minimum of this field and any stricter grant, policy, deployment, or profile override. Defaults to 86400000 ms (24h). See zh/authz/capabilities.md §10.1.

bottom_escalation_after_ms.description: Optional timeout after which unresolved bottom diagnostics should be escalated to recovery governance. Expiry does not choose a winner automatically.

cell_lattices.description: Optional Realm-specific lattice declarations for extension cell families.

allOf.$comment: single_signer notary profiles bind one frozen signer descriptor. controller_organization / recovery_controller_organizations / recovery_members are required ONLY when the deployment can derive a controlling organization (see notary.controller_organization 'when ... can derive it'; decisions/0003 §7 — personal / organization-less Realms legitimately omit them and fall back to per-user recovery). When a controller_organization IS declared, an explicit recovery-notary diversity path MUST accompany it. The distinct-controller arithmetic stays semantic/reducer validation because JSON Schema cannot compare DID-controller derivations across resolver evidence.
Organization-controlled single_signer Realms MUST declare the recovery-notary diversity path alongside the controlling organization.

Threshold notary committees must declare their equivocation culprit-attribution mode at Realm create time. The arithmetic rule (quorum_intersection iff 2*threshold > signers.length) is reducer/conformance validation; see notary.forensic_attribution $comment.

Principal-control and managed-Agent-control Realms share the ak.profile.principal_control_realm.v1 materialized guard. fields.purpose and schema_refs must appear together, the Realm MUST be MLS-backed, history_access MUST be permanently pinned to since_join, and both encryption floors MUST be pinned to e2ee_required (key-management §4.1 / §5.0.1, realm-and-space §2.8.1). There is no plaintext-floor PCR in v1.

The inverse guard prevents a profile-tagged Realm from omitting the machine-readable principal-control or managed-Agent-control purpose discriminator, and pins history_access and both encryption floors symmetrically with the forward guard.

Direct Conversation Realms are ordinary Collaboration Realms with a closed machine role. The discriminator and profile must appear together; history_access is permanently pinned to since_join and create-locked Realm security fields are pinned here while the exact-two membership, participant identity, no-Space and main-Strand rules are reducer/profile invariants.
The inverse Direct Conversation guard prevents a profile-tagged ordinary Realm from omitting its collaboration role discriminator or materializing an impossible all-history state.
Principal Control and Direct Conversation are mutually exclusive Realm roles.

notary_signer_descriptor.description: Historical Seal signer truth. verification_method controller must project to actor_id; frozen_public_key_digest is SHA-256 of decoded frozen_public_key_b64u, while key_kind and jose_algorithm determine exact parsing and signature verification. Genesis freezes the first descriptors. A successor ak.realm.notary Move is authorized by predecessor-state descriptors and then installs new descriptors.

notary_configuration.description: notary.kind is the sole profile discriminator. Across signers, recovery_signers, and their union, actor_id, verification_method, and frozen_public_key_digest are each duplicate-free; signer and recovery slots are disjoint on all three axes. threshold must not exceed signers.length. Admission enforces these field-wise invariants in addition to JSON structural uniqueness.

cell_role.description: Semantic role declared by Realm schema. Security-root roles are restricted to control-plane lattice semantics by the allOf rules below.

plane.description: CBA plane for this cell family. authorization_root / policy_root / notary_root / membership / lifecycle MUST be control. Ordinary content / draft / cosmetic cells SHOULD be data unless sealed=true.

sealed.description: Opt-in control-plane finality for an otherwise data-like cell family. When true, plane MUST be control. A data-like family reused as an authorization input for any risk_tier=high capability MUST set sealed=true; ordinary authorization_root declarations are already required to use plane=control.

initial_value.description: Optional cell schema initial value (cas_register only). When defined, the cas_register `join` algorithm initialises `current` to this value (rather than null) before applying any Move. Combined with a `head_eq: <initial_value>` predicate on the first set Move, this implements singleton-once-set cells via the empty sentinel pattern. See event-auth-state-resolution.md §9.3.1.

sentinel_writers.description: Optional companion to `initial_value` (cas_register only). When `initial_value` is declared, set ops whose effect equals the sentinel are rejected by default (initial_value_reserved). Listing event_kinds here permits those event_kinds to write the sentinel back — typically the cleanup event_kind in a singleton-once-set / explicit-reset workflow. Capability authorization remains a separate independent check. See event-auth-state-resolution.md §9.3.1.

allOf.$comment: sealed=true is the explicit data-to-control opt-in.
initial_value is only defined for cas_register (see event-auth-state-resolution.md §9.3.1). Other lattices reject the field.

sentinel_writers is the companion of initial_value; it only makes sense on a cas_register cell that has declared initial_value. Reject declarations on other lattices, and reject declarations on cas_register cells that lack initial_value (since there is no sentinel to authorise writing back).
